topics.name: Camera Calibration & Intrinsics
topics.description: Intrinsic calibration, lens and radial distortion models, self- and auto-calibration, focal-length estimation and radiometric (photometric) camera calibration.

topics.name: Extrinsic & Multi-Sensor Calibration
topics.description: Camera extrinsics and the rigid transforms between cameras, LiDAR, radar and IMUs: target-based and targetless, hand-eye, spatiotemporal and multi-camera calibration.

topics.name: Generalized & Non-Central Camera Models
topics.description: Cameras modeled as sets of rays: generalized and non-central cameras, multi-camera rigs treated as one generalized camera, Plücker-line formulations, rolling-shutter, light-field/plenoptic and pushbroom models.

topics.name: Omnidirectional, Fisheye & Panoramic Imaging
topics.description: Catadioptric, fisheye, 360-degree and spherical cameras, equirectangular and unified camera models, wide-angle imaging, panorama and image stitching.

topics.name: Single-View & Projective Geometry
topics.description: Vanishing points, horizon lines, Manhattan/Atlanta-world structure, single-view metrology, image rectification, line-segment and wireframe geometry.

topics.name: Epipolar Geometry & Relative Pose
topics.description: Two- and multi-view relations: epipolar constraints, essential and fundamental matrices, homographies, trifocal tensors and relative camera pose.

topics.name: Minimal Solvers & Robust Estimation
topics.description: Minimal solvers and polynomial (Gröbner-basis, homotopy) methods, RANSAC and its variants, consensus maximization, M-estimators and outlier-robust geometric fitting.

topics.name: Absolute Pose & Visual Localization
topics.description: Perspective-n-Point and absolute pose, camera localization and relocalization against maps, scene coordinate regression and absolute pose regression.

topics.name: Feature Matching & Correspondence
topics.description: Keypoint detection and description, sparse, semi-dense and dense feature matching, and geometric correspondence estimation.

topics.name: Structure from Motion & Bundle Adjustment
topics.description: Incremental and global structure from motion, bundle adjustment, rotation, translation and motion averaging, and camera resectioning.

topics.name: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
topics.description: Learned geometry models that regress pointmaps, depth and cameras directly from images (DUSt3R-, MASt3R- and VGGT-style), including pose-free and unposed reconstruction.

topics.name: Stereo & Multi-View Stereo
topics.description: Binocular stereo and disparity estimation, stereo rectification, multi-view stereo, depth fusion and dense surface reconstruction.

topics.name: SLAM & Visual Odometry
topics.description: Visual and visual-inertial odometry, monocular, stereo and RGB-D SLAM, loop closure and pose-graph optimization.

topics.name: Optical Flow, Scene Flow & Ego-Motion
topics.description: Dense 2D and 3D motion: optical flow, scene flow, point tracking, motion fields and camera ego-motion estimation.

topics.name: Monocular Depth & Surface Normals
topics.description: Single-image relative and metric depth estimation, depth completion and surface-normal estimation.

topics.name: Point Cloud Registration
topics.description: Rigid alignment of 3D data: point-cloud and point-set registration, ICP variants, scan matching and image-to-point-cloud registration.

topics.name: Photometric Stereo & Shape-from-X
topics.description: Geometry from light and optics: photometric stereo, shape from shading, polarization and (de)focus, structured light, fringe projection, time-of-flight and inverse rendering.

topics.name: Neural Rendering & Novel View Synthesis
topics.description: Radiance fields (NeRF), 3D Gaussian Splatting, image-based rendering and novel-view synthesis.

topics.name: Photogrammetry & Satellite Geometry
topics.description: Aerial and close-range photogrammetry, aerial triangulation and bundle block adjustment, satellite stereo, rational polynomial camera models, orthorectification and digital surface models.

topics.name: Geo-Localization & Place Recognition
topics.description: Visual place recognition, image and camera geolocation, cross-view (ground-to-aerial and ground-to-satellite) localization and sun-position cues.
